symbols.name: Achieved
symbols.summary: The mission has been completed successfully. An info text will be displayed (default "Mission accomplished") and the accompanying jingle will be played. The mission will be put into status MSTATE_IDLE and no further events will be forwarded to the mission. If system shall be unlocked as a reward then the "keys" parameter should be used. Manual unlocking using NStarsystem.Unlock() will show the unlocked-message before "Mission accomplished" which should be avoided.

returns.name: Timeout
returns.comment: Timeout of the mission in days; 0 == will be offered instantly, <0== will never be offered again

returns.name: Credits
returns.comment: Amount of credits to transfer to the player

returns.name: Text
returns.values: StringId from the string database, default = <StringId of "Mission accomplished">

returns.name: Keys
returns.comment: A list of all systems to unlock

symbols.trigger: Call from a script using NMission.SetState({ State = MSTATE_ACHIEVED })

parameters.name: Camera

symbols.name: Canyon
symbols.summary: An event has occurred within the canyon.

parameters.name: Segment
parameters.comment: The segment the player has now entered (Only applies to CANYON_SEGMENT events).

symbols.example:
{	-- Player is switching the canyon segment
	1.001, 1.007, "Canyon", function( V, Data )
	if CANYON_SEGMENT == Data.Event then
		-- Is the player switching to segment 5?
		if 5 == Data.Segment then
			-- Create an enemy
			...
		end
	end
end }

symbols.name: CommEnd
symbols.summary: A radio message has ended.
symbols.example:
{   -- Waiting for CommEnd
    1.001, 1.001, "CommEnd",
    function( V, Data )

        end
    end
}

symbols.name: FindSystemGroup
symbols.summary: looks for a combination of n systems with special properties. return in 'found' the true value if a combination is found. The parameter Systems uses the same datastructure like FindSytem(table) The algorithm: It will be determined a set of n systems, every set with special properties. Then a combination with not-identical systems must be assembled. If we have 3 sets with 3 elemnts each, the following combinations are tested. ( 1, 1, 1 ), ( 2, 1, 1 ), ( 3, 1, 1 ), ( 1, 2, 1 ), ( 2, 2, 1 ), ( 3, 2, 1 ), ( 1, 3, 1 ), ( 2, 3, 1 ), ( 3, 3, 1 ), ( 1, 1, 2 ), ( 2, 1, 2 ), ( 3, 1, 2 ), ( 1, 2, 2 ), ( 2, 2, 2 ), ( 3, 2, 2 ), ( 1, 3, 2 ), ( 2, 3, 2 ), ( 3, 3, 2 ), ( 1, 1, 3 ), ( 2, 1, 3 ), ( 3, 1, 3 ), ( 1, 2, 3 ), ( 2, 2, 3 ), ( 3, 2, 3 ), ( 1, 3, 3 ), ( 2, 3, 3 ), ( 3, 3, 3 ), Parameter table Return table

symbols.signature: CreateShip( { Type, Look, Race, Level, Segment, StartSpline, EndSpline } ) : { Ship }
symbols.summary: Creates a canyon ship using the supplied parameters. "StartSpline" and "EndSpline" will not always be used but are mandatory to be supplied (see table below). The ships normally do not have any velocity except for the type "CST_ENTER".

parameters.name: Type
parameters.values: CST_ON_SPLINE, CST_ON_SPLINE_REVERSE, CST_ENTER, CST_ENTER_REVERSE, CST_HOVER, CST_HOVER_REVERSE, CST_LANDING
parameters.comment: Motion sequence of the ship (see table below)

parameters.name: Look
parameters.values: SPACE_TRANSPORTER, SPACE_PIRATE, SPACE_POLICE, SPACE_MILITARY, SPACE_HUNTER, SPACE_SKAADRONE, SPACE_PIRATE_FREIGHTER

parameters.name: Segment
parameters.comment: Number of the segment to place the ship in.

parameters.name: StartSpline
parameters.values: SPLINE_PLAYER, SPLINE_AI_0, SPLINE_AI_1, SPLINE_AI_2, SPLINE_AI_3, SPLINE_OVERTURN, SPLINE_ENTER
parameters.comment: Spline to create the ship on.

parameters.name: EndSpline
parameters.values: SPLINE_PLAYER, SPLINE_AI_0, SPLINE_AI_1, SPLINE_AI_2, SPLINE_AI_3, SPLINE_OVERTURN, SPLINE_ENTER
parameters.comment: Spline the ship will switch to (Certain "Type" values, see table).

returns.name: CST_ON_SPLINE
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the first position of the spline within this segment and then follow the spline.

returns.name: CST_ON_SPLINE_REVERSE
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the last spline position of this segment, flying in reverse direction.

returns.name: CST_ENTER
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the "SPLINE_ENTER" spline of the segment and follow this until end. It then switches to "EndSpline" and follows that spline.

returns.name: CST_ENTER_REVERSE
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the "SPLINE_ENTER" spline of the segment and will follow this until end. It then switches to "EndSpline" and follows that spline in reverse direction. Will only work if "SPLINE_ENTER" was also designed for an opposite direction.

returns.name: CST_HOVER
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the first position of the "StartSpline" spline and hover there. Calling a SetShipLiftOff() command for this ship will make it lift off and follow the spline "EndSpline".

returns.name: CST_HOVER_REVERSE
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the first position of the "StartSpline" spline and hover there. Calling a SetShipLiftOff() command for this ship will make it lift off and follow the spline "EndSpline" in opposite direction.

returns.name: CST_LANDING
returns.comment: Ship will be placed onto the first position of the "StartSpline" spline and follow this until its end. It will then approach the first position of "EndSpline". The alignment is controlled by the first two points of "EndSpline".

{
	Type = CST_ENTER,    
	Look = SPACE_HUNTER,    
	Race = RACE_MORTHOK,    
	Level = V.AILevel,    
	Segment = V.EntrySegment,    
	StartSpline = SPLINE_ENTER,    
	EndSpline = SPLINE_AI_0 + Splinechoice ) 
}.Ship

symbols.name: AddMessage
symbols.signature: AddMessage( { Text, Voice, Video, Sender, CommInOut, Actor } ) : { Message }
symbols.summary: Sends a high-priority radio message which automatically aborts all currently active messages of the simulation. If multiple messages are sent using this function, they will be played sequentially. If a radio message ends, a "CommEnd" event will be triggered. If the "Video" parameter is used instead of "Sender" then a video is chosen that fits the ships type and race. If the "Actor" parameter is used and if this is an NPC Actor (Ramirez, Eona, Nicolai etc.), then that actor will be used. This actor will have priority over the normal actor of the sender, even if "Sender" is supplied. This makes it possible to have a trade station use "Jiju" as its actor without having to call a SetActor() for the station.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.comment: Text to display with this message.

parameters.name: Voice
parameters.values: Prefix of an identifier of a stream resource from the "KlangErzeugerDefault.xml" (KlangErzeuger = SoundCreator) or an absolute identifier for a stream resource from that file.
parameters.comment: Stream to play. If a sender is supplied then "Voice" is the prefix of an identifier from a stream resource from the "KlangErzeugerDefault.xml". The identifier will be extended by the suffix "_<RACE>_<ACTOR>". Race and actor will be extracted from the sender of the message. If no sender is supplied then "Voice" is the absolute identifier of a stream resource from the "KlangErzeugerDefault.xml".

parameters.name: Video
parameters.values: Path to a .bik video file (complete path + ".bik").
parameters.comment: The video to play along with the message. If none is specified, the video will be chosen based on the sender of the message. If no sender is specified then an empty video (green screen with static noise) will be played.

parameters.name: Sender
parameters.comment: Sender of the radio message. Used to select video and sound file.

parameters.name: CommInOut
parameters.comment: CommIn and CommOut video snippets (a green opening or closing screen) are played(true) or left away(false)

parameters.name: Actor
parameters.comment: Actor, to use for this radio message. Needs to be an NPC and not a standard actor.

returns.name: Message
returns.comment: Id of the message (Needs to be stored to handle a later "CommEnd" event).

symbols.example:
-- Send a radio message
-- If the supplied ship is a human hunter with actor 0 then the video will be "HUNTER_HUMAN_00.bik"
-- and the sound file will be "IDM_GLOBAL_5000_MSG_TXT_SPOKEN_HUMAN_00.mp3".
V.MsgId = NComm.AddMessage( 
{ 
	Text="IDM_GLOBAL_5000_MSG_TXT", 
	Voice="IDM_GLOBAL_5000_MSG_TXT_SPOKEN", 
	Sender=V.Ship, 
	CommInOut=true 
} ).MessageId

-- Kayron is to say something
NShip.SetActor( { Ship = MissionLib.GetPlayerHandle(), Actor = "kayron" } )
NComm.SendMessage( 
{ Sender = 
	MissionLib.GetPlayerHandle(), 
	Text = "IDM_DONT_TALK_AROUND", 
	CommInOut = false 
} )

-- Eona says something but the actor of the player ship will not be changed
NComm.SendMessage( 
{ 
	Sender = MissionLib.GetPlayerHandle(), 
	Text = "IDM_EONA_WOBBLEDY", 
	Actor = "eona", 
	CommInOut = false 
} )

-- Ramirez says something although he is not present in space.
NComm.SendMessage(
{ 
	Text = "IDM_GHOST",
	Actor = "ramirez", 
	CommInOut = true 
} )

symbols.name: Create
symbols.summary: Erzeugt einen Container des angegebenen Typs ( siehe Typtabelle ). Depending on the type one of the parameters "Ship", "PosDesc" or "Position" is necessary. If the ship is the player ship and it has docked at the station then a mission container can be created using "CONTAINER_SHIP". This slot will be taken by the container.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.comment: Size or type of the container.

parameters.name: Ship
parameters.comment: Ship to attach the container to. Must be able to carry this size of container.

returns.name: CONTAINER_SPACE
returns.values: Container will be created in the supplied creation region.

returns.name: CONTAINER_SHIP
returns.values: Container will be created and docked. Ship must be a freighter.

returns.name: CONTAINER_POSITION
returns.values: Container is created at an arbitrary position in space (or close to it).

symbols.example:
-- Create a container on a freighter
V.Container = NContainer.Create( { Type=CONTAINER_SHIP, Ship=V.Trader } ).Container

-- Create a container behind the trade station
V.ContainerSpace = NContainer.Create( { Type=CONTAINER_SPACE, PosDesc=POSDESCR_OFFSET } ).Container

-- Create a container in 1000m distance above the trade station.
V.ContainerPos = NContainer.Create( { Type=CONTAINER_POSITION, Position={0,1000,0} } ).Container

symbols.name: CreateLoot
symbols.summary: Creates a loot (previously artifact) container with the specified contents. If neither UniqueItems nor Artefact is supplied then an artifact will be put into the container. The loot container can only be created for a ship which is currently exploding, that means during handling of its "StarshipDestroyed" event. The container will be placed at the position of the ship and will initially move along the last velocity vector of the ship. At the same time it slightly rotates.

parameters.name: Ship
parameters.comment: Handle of a ship which is currently exploding.

parameters.name: UniqueItems
parameters.comment: Number of secret service weapons contained in the container.

parameters.name: Artefact
parameters.comment: If >0 then an artifact will be put into the container.

symbols.example:
{   -- Create loot container with 2 secred service weapons
    1.0, 1.0, "StarshipDestroyed", function( V, Data )
    if Data.Ship == V.BossShip then
        NContainer.CreateLoot( { Ship=V.BossShip, UniqueItems=2 } )
    end
end },

symbols.name: Destroy
symbols.summary: Destroys the specified container. The container disappears and does NOT trigger a "CONTAINER_DESTROYED" event.
symbols.example:
{   -- Player reaches the station in the destination system: destroy the stored mission container
    2.001, 2.001, "EnterStation",
    function( V, Data )
        if V.DestSystem == Data.System then
            if V.Cont then
                NContainer.Destroy( { Container=V.Cont } )
                V.Cont = nil
            end
        end
    end
}

symbols.name: Equip
symbols.summary: Fills an existing container with the supplied goods. If "Amount" is not specified then the container will be filled to its full capacity. If "Amount" exceeds the remaining capacity then the excess will be ignored. For mission goods (containers filled with a StringId) the "Amount" parameter has no effect.

symbols.example:
-- Completely fill a container with machinery.
NContainer.Equip( { Container=V.Conti, Goods=GOODS_MACHINERY } )

-- Fill a container with a mission good
NContainer.Equip( { Container=V.Conti, Goods="IDM_GLOBAL_5000_GOODS" } )

-- Fill a container with different trade goods
NContainer.Equip( { Container=V.Conti, Goods=GOODS_MACHINERY, Amount=20 } )
NContainer.Equip( { Container=V.Conti, Goods=GOODS_CRYSTALS, Amount=50 } )
NContainer.Equip( { Container=V.Conti, Goods=GOODS_PROTEINS, Amount=30 } )

symbols.example:
-- We need to find out if the container is an artifact container
  cont = NContainer.GetType( { Container=V.Container } )

symbols.name: SetAlignment
symbols.summary: Sets the alignment of a container and places it on a specified location. The front of it points at position "Front". If "UpDir" is not specified then the container will be aligned to the y-axis of the system. The position needs to be unoccupied in order for the logic to not detect a collision within the next timestep.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.comment: Absolute coordinates (default value is the current position)

parameters.name: Front
parameters.comment: Direction vector the container axis points at(default is the current direction)

parameters.name: UpDir
parameters.comment: Direction vector the upside of the container faces.

symbols.example:
-- Create an artifact container
V.Cont = NContainer.Create( { Type=CONTAINER_SPACE, Size=CONTAINER_ARTIFACT, PosDesc=POSDESCR_INTERCEPTION } ).Container

-- Place the container on a certain position
NContainer.SetAlignment( { Container=V.Cont, Position={0.0,3000.0,0.0}, Front={0.0,-3000.0,10000.0} } )

-- Orientate the container in such a way that it is lieing on the x-z plane.
NContainer.SetAlignment( { Container=V.Cont } )

returns.name: AI_ACTION_POSITION2
returns.type: Speed matters. PosX, PosY, PosZ is the target position.
returns.values: The wing moves to the given coordinates. The wing will alter its heading

returns.name: AI_ACTION_OBJECT1
returns.type: Speed matters. Handle is a SpaceObject
returns.values: Wing moves to that object. Enemies will not attacked

returns.name: AI_ACTION_OBJECT2
returns.type: Speed matters. Handle is a SpaceObject
returns.values: Wing moves to that object. Enemies will be attacked

returns.name: AI_ACTION_LAND
returns.type: Handle is a SpaceObject with a hangar (station or cruiser)
returns.values: Wing lands on that object if no enemies are near.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_LANDNOW
returns.type: Handle is a SpaceObjects with a hangar
returns.values: Wing lands on that object, even if enemies are near.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_CIRCLE
returns.values: Like AI_ACTION_WARTEN but the wing is circulating around the actual position. Gets the wing an enemy, circulating will be interupted

returns.name: AI_ACTION_PATROL
returns.type: Speed matters. PosX, PosY, PosZ are absolute positions.
returns.values: Here 4 or more positions may follow. The wing moves to each position.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_PROTECT
returns.type: Handle is a WingHandle, Position a direction vector from the leader of given handle to the leader of the Wing.
returns.values: one wing protect another. The wing follows the other in an standard distance

returns.name: AI_ACTION_DROP
returns.values: If Handle is a container this container is dropped, else all ships are dropping thier container

returns.name: AI_ACTION_HYPERJUMP
returns.type: Handle must be a CStarHandle if it is the players wing
returns.values: The wing jumps into hyperspace. Is the player in it, he jumps with it to the given system (camera incl.) A mission wing consisting out of AI-shipa will be deleted (WING_DESTROYED is called)

returns.name: AI_ACTION_HYPERJUMPNOW
returns.type: Handle must be a CStarHandle, if it is the players wing.
returns.values: like AI_ACTION_HYPERRAUM but no ships from the enemy list will be attacked.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_BOSSCIRCLE
returns.values: The wing circles around a position. Speed is taken as radius. This state doesn't end if an enemy is entered in its target list.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_ENTRY
returns.type: Handle is a CStarHandle or a CWingHandle.
returns.values: Wing battles enemies near it. Arrives the wing in a system the next action will be started.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_ESCORT
returns.values: The wing moves to a position. Little ships (even leaders) may leave the formation to attack enemies.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_FOLLOWSHIP
returns.values: Handle must be a ship of another wing, which should be followed. Position defines the direction of the ship to the leader of the following wing.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_POSATTACK
returns.values: The given 3D position is flown at and fired upon.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_ACTIONTURRET
returns.type: Handle will be entered into the enemy list.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_DESTROYOBJ
returns.values: Wing will move in front of the object and fire its primary weapons.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_GETLIST
returns.values: A new action from the action list should start

returns.name: AI_ACTION_POLICESCAN
returns.values: This order only works with wings created as WINGTYPE_POLICE ! Wing moves to a position. The player ship is scanned if it is near.

returns.name: AI_ACTION_SKAA_ATTACK
returns.values: This order only works with wings created as WINGTYPE_SKAA ! The wing attacks the ship

returns.name: AI_ACTION_SKAA_ACTIONTURRET
returns.values: This order only works with wings created as WINGTYPE_SKAA ! if a CActionTurret is active, the target will be attacked. Other targets will be ignored.

symbols.example:
-- Wing shall move to a position at once and start circulating there.
NWing.AddAction( {Wing=V.WingId, List=LIST_ACTIVE, First=1,Actions={ {Type=AI_ACTION_POSITION1, Speed=1.2, Position={2039.0,5095.0,-5393.0} },{Type=AI_ACTION_KREISEN,Speed=1.2} }})

-- When the wing only has one ship left, make it drop all containers and jump away
NWing.AddAction( {Wing=V.WingId, List=LIST_LAST_SHIP, First=1,Actions={ {Type=AI_ACTION_ABWERFEN},{Type=AI_ACTION_HYPERRAUM, Handle=V.StarId} } } )

symbols.name: AddEnemy
symbols.summary: Insert a new enemy into the enemy list of that wing. Target can be a WingHandle or a StarShipHandle. If a wing is entered, all ships of that wing are added with a priority. If a ship is added, only that ship is added with a priority. Is a ship in a wing all ships get the standard priority of 0.2 is used. Priority influences the target selection of the wing ships.

symbols.name: Create
symbols.signature: Create( { WingType, Number, Level, LevelOffset, Names, Race, PosType, Position|Object|Distance|FrontDir|UpDir } ) : { Wing, PosLeader }
symbols.summary: Creates a wing and returns its handle

parameters.name: Number
parameters.comment: Number of ships in the wing, 0 creates a standard wing

parameters.name: LevelOffset
parameters.comment: Enemy level is calculated as Player level + level offset.

parameters.name: Names
parameters.comment: A field of StringIDs. Ship i gets name index i+1. If there is no name it gets the last name in the list.

parameters.name: Race
parameters.comment: if RACE_RANDOM the automatic race distribution (cluster based) is used

symbols.example:
-- Hunter in Interception area
V.Wing = NWing.Create( {WingType=WINGTYPE_HUNTER, Number=0, Level=3, Race=RACE_MORTHOK, PosType=POSDESCR_INTERCEPTION} ).Wing

-- Pirate freighter at a defined position
V.PirFreighter = NWing.Create( {WingType=WINGTYPE_PIRATEFREIGHTER, Number=1, PosType=POSDESCR_EXPLICIT, Position={250.0, -4000.0, 8000.0} } ).Wing

-- a pirate wing 500m aside a pirate freighter
V.Pirate = NWing.Create( {WingType=WINGTYPE_RAIDERS, Number=4, PosType=POSDESCR_WINGDISTANCE, Object=V.PirFreighter, Distance=500.0 } ).Wing

symbols.name: Define
symbols.signature: Define( { WingType, Ships, Names, PosType, Position|Object|Distance|FrontDir|UpDir } ) : { Wing, PosLeader }
symbols.summary: Creates a wing and returns its handle

parameters.name: WingType
parameters.comment: Type of wing. Needs to be given, if the wing needs to have an non missionAI AI.

parameters.name: Names
parameters.comment: A field of StringIDs. Ship i gets name index i+1. If there is no name it gets the last name in the list.

returns.name: LevelOffset
returns.comment: Enemy level is calculated as Player level + level offset.

symbols.example:
-- a human hunter wing will be created at the interception area
V.Wing = NWing.Define( { WingType=WINGTYPE_HUNTER, Ships={{ObjType=ST_WINGMAN, ObjIndex=0, LevelOffset=0}, {ObjType=ST_WINGMAN, ObjIndex=1, Level=4}}, PosType=POSDESCR_INTERCEPTION} ).Wing

-- a mixed mission wing at a defined position.
V.Wing = NWing.Define( { Ships={{ObjType=WINGTYPE_MILITARY, ObjIndex=2, LevelOffset=2}, {ObjType=ST_ST_MILITARYFIGHTER, ObjIndex=1, Level=2}}, PosType=POSDESCR_EXPLICIT,Position={1000.0,1000.0,0.0}, FrontDir={-1.0,-1.0,0.0} } ).Wing

symbols.name: Destroy
symbols.summary: Destroys the given Wing. There is no WING_DESTROYED event fired!

symbols.name: ExecuteAi
symbols.summary: This order forces a wing to rechoose a new AiAction. In that way a Stop-order can be carried out at once.
symbols.example: NWing.ExecuteAi( { Wing=Pirates.Wing } )

symbols.name: IsHostileShip
symbols.summary: It is checked, if an given ship is an enemy of the wing

returns.name: Hostile
returns.comment: is set, if the ship is in the enemy list.

symbols.name: List
symbols.summary: Returns the ship handles of all ships in that wing.

returns.name: ShipList
returns.comment: Handle values of all ships in wing

symbols.name: MakeHostile
symbols.summary: The player becomes an enemy to that wing

symbols.name: NoEnemy
symbols.summary: Clears the enemy list of that wing. If that order is used with a group AI it is possible that the wing starts looking for other enemies. If two groups are fighting each other, both groups have to get the NoEnemy order to stop fighting.

symbols.name: Place
symbols.signature: Place( { Wing, Position, Front, LookAt, BaseObj } )
symbols.summary: Platziert den Leader eines Wings an der angegebenen Position undAusrichtung und platziert alle weiteren Schiffe auf ihre Wingpositionen.Wird 'BaseObj' angegeben, sind 'LookAt' und 'Position' Koordinaten imBezugssystem von 'BaseObj'.

parameters.name: LookAt
parameters.comment: Position or objekt, for the camera look at

symbols.name: SetFormation
symbols.summary: Defines a formation for a wing

symbols.name: SetInvalidEnemy
symbols.summary: This order allows or disallowes a shiptype as enemy of a wing

parameters.name: TypeId
parameters.comment: ship type, which should be allowed or not allowed

parameters.name: Set
parameters.comment: returns if a ship type may be an enemy. else TypeID is not allowed.

symbols.name: SetPlayerEntryPos
symbols.summary: If the players wing should enter a system at a different position than the hypergate. The position must be entered at the PREFADE-Event.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.comment: Position, where the wing should enter the system.

Classes of visibility: STAR_UNLOCKED: A system the player is allowed to enter
STAR_MISSION: A system reserved for a single mission. This mission is available in the actual system
STAR_SYSTEMKEY: A visible system. The key may be given in the actual system.
STAR_GANGSYSTEM A visible system with a pirate gang.
